name: building_life
note: Subtle seamless idle loops for Black Doctrine battle-map buildings (bd_battle_sorted, read-only copies). Only pixels the art already paints as lit (bright + saturated, contrast-checked against the surrounding body) are animated, plus added FX (dish pings, steam/smoke, beacons, landing-light chases, screen scanlines, glass sweeps, star glints); the building body is never recoloured. Each building has a full drop-in clip (exact canvas + anchor of the static sprite) and an overlay-only clip (FX on transparent) for engine layering. Emitter points are in each clip JSON. Phases are seeded per building id so neighbours do not pulse in sync.

selection: Battle placement library (public/assets/library/structure-placements.json, library "battle"): 437 entries, 305 files present in bd_battle_sorted, 216 unique after removing byte-identical duplicates; ranked by painted-emissive pixel score, then 24 hand-picked for feature variety (cooling towers/stacks, dishes, screens, crystals, neon, window grids). No map data in the repo names specific buildings. v2: all remaining unique battle buildings (192) auto-configured with a contrast-checked emissive filter (adaptive threshold for dark neon art), each reviewed by eye (first frame / busiest frame / touched-pixel map) and graded; B or better shipped.

v2.gradeBar: B or better ships (A-, B+, B); B- and below dropped
